title: Stir-Fried Chilies with Sausage
description: A spicy and savory Chinese-inspired dish made with chilisteraksaus, onions, and bell peppers.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the nmolten sausage and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced onions and bell peppers and cook until they start to soften, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the chilisteraksaus and cook for another 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the soy sauce, rice vinegar, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Continue cooking for another 2-3 minutes, until the vegetables are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
Note: adjust the level of spiciness to your liking by adding more or fewer chilies.
